thread:
Sam (Support): Heads-up: customer MeridianPay reported a sharp throughput collapse and a spike in 503s right after their morning surge at 07:40 UTC. They saw ~9% 5xxs and long tail latencies.
Riley (Sales): MeridianPay is in our enterprise trial with a latency SLA. They're asking for immediate mitigation and ETA. Looping @Keiko (PM).
Keiko (PM): Sam, please include route, model, region, concurrency, and any payload examples. Also confirm if a deploy happened around the timeframe.
Sam (Support): Route: /v1/generate (meridianpay-prod). Model: redwood/gpt-2xl-quant. Seq ~520, concurrency ~170 from their clients. Example: `POST /v1/generate {"model":"redwood/gpt-2xl-quant","input":"~450 tokens"}` -> 503 {"error":"instance overload"}. They say the regression began immediately after the 07:35 deploy window.
deploybot: Rollout v2026.09.10.07.35 -> eu-west-1 pool-11
Jordan (Eng): Telemetry: significant pod restarts and autoscaler churn in pool-11 starting 07:36. We have GPU OOMs and kube OOMKills. The rollout included a kernel scheduling heuristic tweak for large KV cache workloads — hypothesis: the heuristic increases memory residency in certain code paths under high concurrency causing OOMs.
Pavel (Oncall): Confirmed OOM events and ingress queueing during the same interval. Several pods restarted and nginx p95 spiked. I'm also seeing elevated GC pauses in agent logs.
Keiko (PM): Quick mitigation options: (A) Per-route override to a lower-memory variant (gpt-2xl-fp16) as a temporary fallback. (B) Hot-route MeridianPay to a dedicated EU pool (if capacity available/provisionable). (C) Full rollback of the heuristic globally. We should weigh blast radius vs customer impact.
Riley (Sales): MeridianPay prefers the least disruptive option that preserves output quality. They requested a canary so they can validate quality before a full switch.
Jordan (Eng): Practical steps: push a routing override canary (100 requests, 10% traffic) to gpt-2xl-fp16 and monitor p95 and error rate for 10 minutes. If stable, promote to 100% and observe for 2 hours. If still problematic, spin up dedicated pool in eu-west-1 (~35-50m provisioning). Full rollback estimated ~1h and impacts all pools.
Pavel (Oncall): I'll add a temporary alert rule: `meridianpay_error_rate > 2% for 1m` -> page eng-oncall. Monitoring node OOMs, ingress latency, and pod restart rate.
Sam (Support): MeridianPay agrees to a 100-request canary with a 10/90 split. They've asked for the output diff to be assessed on the canary.
Keiko (PM): OK decision: execute canary fallback (option A) first. Action owners: Jordan -> apply routing override canary and upload logs; Pavel -> infra monitoring and paging thresholds; Sam -> coordinate with customer; Riley -> customer comms and SLA note. We'll create backlog items for RCA and product fixes.
Jordan (Eng): Applying route override: `PATCH /v1/routes/meridianpay-prod` body: `{ "model_override": "redwood/gpt-2xl-fp16", "canary_pct": 10, "canary_requests": 100 }` (pushing now).
Pavel (Oncall): Monitoring live. Added short-lived alert and watch dashboard. If error rate > 3% for 1m escalate to eng-runtime.
Sam (Support): Canary executed. MeridianPay reports initial 100 requests: p95 ~300ms, error rate 0.9% (down from 9%). They want a 2-hour stability window after a full switch and will review a small sample for quality.
Riley (Sales): Communicated canary outcome and next steps. Customer is relieved but requests RCA + timeline for a permanent fix. I'm flagging potential SLA credit risk with finance.
Keiko (PM): Backlog commitments and owners:
- P0 RCA ticket: reproduce mem-residency spike with heuristic + high concurrency. Owner: Jordan. Due 72h. Acceptance: reproducible test in staging, targeted fix or mitigation, perf regression benchmarks.
- P1 Product: spec auto-fallback routing policy for mem-pressure that can be configured per-customer. Owner: Keiko. Due: 2 sprints. Acceptance: product doc + API backing and ops playbook.
- P1 Ops: update rollback/playbook with step-by-step customer mitigation actions. Owner: Pavel. Due: 5 days. Acceptance: tested runbook and communication templates.
- P2 Customer SLA impact calculation and comms draft. Owner: Riley. Due: 12h.
Jordan (Eng): Created RCA ticket RC-9021 and uploaded pod logs, heapdumps, and a preliminary reproducer plan. Keeping override in place for 2h then reassess.
deploybot: RC-9021 created by jordan (Eng)
Keiko (PM): Customer-facing acceptance criteria to close the incident:
- MeridianPay p95 < 400ms and error rate < 1% for 2 continuous hours
- RCA delivered with remediation plan and scheduled fix deployed to staging for canary without regressions
- Product spec for per-route auto-fallback added to roadmap and prioritized
Sam (Support): Noted. I'll check in with MeridianPay in 1 hour and update this thread.
Pavel (Oncall): If error rate creeps above 2% we'll escalate and consider capacity move to dedicated pool. Rota on standby.
Riley (Sales): I'll prepare an hourly update template and notify legal/finance about SLA exposure.
Jordan (Eng): Canary looks clean so far, promoting to 100% now and continuing to stream logs to RC-9021.
Sam (Support): MeridianPay confirms 100% routed to fp16 variant. Current p95 ~340ms; error rate 0.5%. They asked for hourly updates for the next 2 hours and a postmortem.
Keiko (PM): Thanks team. We'll treat RC-9021 as P0 and the auto-fallback feature as the roadmap outcome. Keep updates in this thread and link artifacts to the RCA ticket. :white_check_mark:
